    return [[grid[i][j] for j in keep_cols] for i in keep_rows]

    rows = [grid[0][:]]

        col = [row[j] for row in rows]
        prev = [row[-1] for row in out]
        if col != prev:
            for i, value in enumerate(col):
                out[i].append(value)
    return out
",
